extension.summary: Apple Siri Remote support for Kodi
extension.description: Connects to an Apple Siri Remote via Bluetooth and maps button presses to Kodi actions. Supports navigation, play/pause, volume control, and more.
extension.news:
v1.1.0 (2025-10-23) - Added support for multiple remote configuration (up to 4 remotes) - Each remote can be individually enabled/disabled - Added custom naming for each remote - Automatic migration from old single-remote settings - Note: Multi-remote connection coming in future update
v1.0.0 (2025-10-17) - Initial release - Support for Apple Siri Remote button mapping - Configurable MAC address via settings - Enable/disable toggle
